guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table reference documentation overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Lean on intrinsic sizing and the browser layout engine; keep overflow contained; wrap potentially-wide tables (overflow-x:auto) rather than letting them force page overflow; overflow-wrap on cells with long tokens.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: every table sits in .table-wrap{overflow-x:auto}; compat tables get min-widths so they scroll within the wrap instead of crushing columns; overflow-wrap:anywhere on th/td, h1, lede, and inline code; pre blocks overflow-x:auto; no fixed pixel layout widths.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Semantic HTML structure, labelled tables, heading hierarchy, meaningful landmarks, no keyboard traps in static reference content.
